targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, SUM(metric_value) AS value, device_name AS metric FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_in_octets%' AND device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY timestamp, device_name ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS time, SUM(metric_value) AS value, device_name AS metric FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_out_octets%' AND device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY timestamp, device_name ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS time, SUM(metric_value) AS value, device_name || ' in-err' AS metric FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_in_errors%' AND device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY timestamp, device_name ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT timestamp AS time, SUM(metric_value) AS value, device_name || ' out-err' AS metric FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_out_errors%' AND device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY timestamp, device_name ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT device_name, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metric_count, MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE 'if_in_octets%' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_in_octets, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE 'if_out_octets%' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_out_octets, SUM(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%error%' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_errors FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes' GROUP BY device_name ORDER BY device_name
